scope: Original PVR real first-entry rounds; E31 sensitivity separate, never pooled; all 2022-01-04 through 2026-05-14 signal dates, account endpoint 2026-05-15. Main labels are full completed rounds at endpoint. Dedicated 2022 original year-end closure uses closed_in_entry_year to preserve 130/692 identity. Open rounds unknown, not losses.
feature: Exactly prior design: sqrt21*z at each direction confirmation, z from original CP cache; separate price DC state not reset by I/CP. R=max(H-x,0)/(H-L+current frozen phase delta), q=1/(1+R). Provisional L in DOWN. Unknown not imputed.
matching: Within same signal day, winner round_pnl>0 vs loser round_pnl<0; each original H1 and PVR absolute distance <=5 points. Sort candidate edges by Euclidean score distance then winner sid and loser sid then original row ID; greedy one-to-one without replacement within each account/scope. Do not widen caliper for low sample count. No outcome used to compute R; outcomes used to form descriptive pairs. Report support and distances.
summaries: Year and quarter counts and means/medians; paired R_loss-R_win positive share incl zero ties and distinct days/stocks. R=0 vs >0 structural coverage and fixed numeric intervals 0,(0,.25],(.25,.5],(.5,.75],(.75,1]. No selected threshold or performance optimization. Report weak market separately, original big60_posthoc and full round return>=30% separately. Existing forward labels are descriptive not attainable returns.
boundaries: No account replay, new ranking, execution inference, refitting, parameter grid, random sampling, or independent out-of-sample claim. Core and fresh-CP subset separate. No new independent data.
